title: Zetta-Joule service
description: A white section with a featherlight heading top-left, two small paragraphs and a button bottom-left, and a huge illustration filling the right two-thirds. Desktop: one window tall and pinned, so the next section slides up over it. Phones: heading, illustration, paragraphs, button in a column.
notes: desktop height is the window (h-svh, at least 46rem); the sections after it need their own background and `relative z-10` to slide over it (team, workforce, cta, footer do)
the illustration is 571×376 on phones; empty shows a placeholder
